notes.description: Optional compact run memory for yourself next turn: current build plan, important purchases, priorities, and tactical reminders. This is not sent to the game.

function.name: pack_pick
function.description: Pick a card from the opened booster pack (see state.pack.cards) by index, or skip it. Tarot/Spectral cards that act on your cards ALSO need `targets` = indices of cards in state.hand_cards (the pack card's effect says how many, e.g. 1-2). To skip the pack, pass skip:true (not skip:false).

targets.description: Hand-card indices to target, required by tarot/spectral cards that modify your cards

skip.description: Pass true to skip the pack without picking

notes.description: Optional compact run memory for yourself next turn: current build plan, important purchases, priorities, and tactical reminders. This is not sent to the game.
